blockers.sought: No union agreement or fixed rate sets a film director's pay in Hungary: FOCAL's Hungarian correspondent reports no unions and no fixed rates, deals being made project by project. (Finding withdrawn 2026-11-01: its only source, FOCAL Production Value, focal.ch/prodvalue/working_conditions/hungary.html, rests on its Hungarian correspondent's own report, which names no published primary; it lands again on the National Film Institute's, a union's or a collective-agreement register's own statement.)
